messages:
Jessica (Finance): Payment hit bank feed from 'Acme Ltd' for £12,450 on 2026-03-16 — no invoice number or PO in the reference. Bank reference: 0x7F9A (PDF attached to payment). Can someone help reconcile?
Sam (Support): Got a ticket from the customer saying they paid via BACS and referenced their internal PO but not our invoice number. They pasted: 'Payment of 12,450 GBP via CHAPS — ref XFER12345'.
Leo (Customer Success): I asked the customer for the remittance advice. They sent back a bank PDF that shows payer name and amount but only `XFER12345` in the narrative. No invoice/PO visible.
payments-bot: Bank feed entry: id=bnk_20260316_998, amount=12450.00 GBP, currency=GBP, posted_at=2026-03-16T09:12:05Z, payer_name="ACME LIMITED".
Arjun (Sales): Likely customer accounting used our company name but left invoice id out. We can try matching by amount + payer + date range. Could be fees or currency rounding involved.
Marta (Ops): Quick candidate search SQL to find likely invoices (run in analytics):
```sql
SELECT id, customer_id, total_amount, currency, created_at
FROM invoices
WHERE customer_name ILIKE '%acme%'
  AND ABS(total_amount - 12450.00) < 5
  AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-02-15' AND '2026-03-20'
ORDER BY created_at DESC;
```
Sam (Support): Good. Also search payments table for matches by converted USD amount (customer sometimes paid from a USD account and bank converted).
Jessica (Finance): I ran the SQL — two candidates: INV-2026-0312 (12,450.00 GBP) created 2026-03-10 and INV-2026-0298 (12,450.00 GBP) created 2026-03-11. Both to Acme Ltd. No matching remittance ref.
Leo (Customer Success): I can ask customer to confirm the invoice number or forward the payment confirmation SWIFT message — they often get `MT103` with our beneficiary ref. Requesting that now.
Arjun (Sales): If they can't, we can match on exact amount + bank account last4 + date within 3 days and apply, but need explicit approval from finance for manual apply.
Jessica (Finance): Agreed — finance policy: require at least two matching attributes (amount + payer name or amount + bank reference). If only amount matches we need remittance note. For now I will hold and wait 24h for remittance PDF.
Sam (Support): Drafted a short email for the customer asking for either: 1) remittance advice or MT103 screenshot, or 2) confirmation of invoice numbers/POs paid. Will send now. 
Leo (Customer Success): Sent — customer replied they'll escalate in their AP team and send proof by EOD.
Marta (Ops): Longer-term suggestion: include a machine-readable payment reference on invoices: e.g., "Payment reference: RED-INV-<invoice_id>" and display it prominently in the PDF and email. Also enable a webhook that accepts customer-provided remittance PDFs and attaches them to the invoice automatically.
Arjun (Sales): +1. Also recommend we add a field for PO number in the hosted billing portal so customers can include PO on payments.
Jessica (Finance): Action items: 1) Wait for remittance (Leo to follow up), 2) If remittance arrives, match and apply to INV-2026-0312 or INV-2026-0298, 3) If not received by EOD tomorrow, escalate to legal/account manager for approval to apply based on heuristics.
Sam (Support): Noted. Will tag `@arjun` and `@jessica` on the support ticket when the customer uploads the remittance. :white_check_mark:
payments-bot: Note: added internal tag `recon:pending` to bank entry bnk_20260316_998.
Jessica (Finance): After matching, remember to check VAT treatment (customer provided no VAT breakdown — confirm whether reverse-charge applies). I'll verify VAT code before final posting.
Leo (Customer Success): I'll update the customer about VAT check as well.
Arjun (Sales): If this becomes frequent we should create an automated reconciliation rule: match by amount + payer_name similarity > 0.85 and auto-apply for customers with good payment history.
Marta (Ops): Filed a ticket in ops backlog to prototype the rule and add a small UI for manual overrides.
Jessica (Finance): Thanks everyone. I'll update this thread once payment is applied or if we need to create a credit note.
